sections.heading: Playing Strategies
sections.wikitext:
'''Thornment, Sand Snake's''' card is brilliant because of its solid ATK and DEF stats while, being a minor hero, it can be used without stopping you from summoning more powerful Major Hero Cards. You can move Thornment into zones where there are other Sand Snake cards providing a useful reinforcement for combats where you have a sand snake card.
